metadata.description: Academic research skills for AI agents: find and review the literature in 250 million real papers, read papers closely, and prepare, check and revise manuscripts.

plugins.name: researchzy
plugins.description: Find and review the literature with real papers: search about 250 million records, manage your library and PDFs, and write literature reviews that cite only what the search returned. Needs a Researchzy account.

plugins.name: researchzy-reading
plugins.description: Read papers with your agent: lawful full-text downloads, a close reading of one paper, and structured Paper Cards. Works on your own PDFs; no account needed.

plugins.name: researchzy-manuscript
plugins.description: Prepare a manuscript with your agent: check that references are real and correct, review statistical reporting, draft Data and Code Availability statements and answer reviewers. No account needed.
